name: YMCA Summer Club at Grassy Plain
street_address: YMCA Children's Center at Grassy Plain, 57 Grassy Plain Street
description_short: A YMCA summer day camp for ages 5 to 12 at the Y's air conditioned children's center in Bethel, open 7:30 am to 5:30 pm. Campers follow theme weeks with STEAM projects, art, drama, literacy and math games, outdoor play on two playgrounds and a field, and special days.
